prompt: Label this issue of Toskar, a local AI app.

groups.name: type
groups.ask: type: the one kind of issue it is:

labels.enhancement: A new feature or an improvement
labels.question: A question, or more information or discussion is needed

groups.name: area
groups.ask: area: the part of Toskar the issue is mainly about: usually one, two only when both are central, none when nothing fits well. Don't add an area just because the issue touches it:

labels.performance: Performance, latency, memory, or resource usage
labels.runtime: AI runtimes and backends, such as llama.cpp, and models running on them
labels.networking: Networking, discovery, pairing, remote access, or connectivity
labels.orchestration: Scheduling, routing, agents, tools, or how an answer is put together
labels.api: The control API or the OpenAI-compatible API
labels.translation: Text in a language other than English, or a new language
labels.tests: Tests, CI checks, and the quality suite

groups.name: platform
groups.ask: platform: only when the issue happens on, or is specifically about, that platform or hardware. Usually none: [].
